newsitem.title: USA: Dauphin Deposit sets 1:1 merger ratio.
newsitem.headline: Dauphin Deposit sets 1:1 merger ratio.

text.p: Dauphin Deposit Corp and Allied Irish Banks Plc on Tuesday said Dauphin shareholders who elect to receive stock as part of the companies' merger plan will receive one Allied Irish american depositary share for each share of Dauphin common stock they own.
The merger between Dauphin, Allied Irish and AIB's First Maryland Bancorp subsidiary was announced in January and valued at $1.36 billion.

In a statement, the companies said the 1:1 stock exchange ratio was based on the average closing price on the New York Stock Exchange of Allied Irish ADSs for the 10 trading days ending June 30, 1997.
The average closing price was $46.925, and the merger agreement provided for a 1:1 exchange ratio if the average closing price of Allied Irish ADSs was $43 or higher, the companies said.
